0:
mkdir -p /home/nonroot/.claude
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/claude-settings.json /home/nonroot/.claude/settings.json
[ -f /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md ] || cp /home/nonroot/config/CLAUDE.md /home/nonroot/.claude/CLAUDE.md
claude mcp remove -s user victoriametrics 2>/dev/null
claude mcp remove -s user chrome-devtools 2>/dev/null
claude mcp add -s user --transport http victoriametrics http://mcp-victoriametrics.victoria-metrics.svc.cluster.local:8080/mcp
claude mcp add -s user --transport http chrome-devtools http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp

while true; do
  rm -rf /tmp/chrome
  chromium-browser --headless --remote-debugging-port=9222 --no-sandbox --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome
  sleep 1
done

[[runners]]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    helper_image = "ghcr.io/vaskozl/gitlab-runner-helper:latest"
    cpu_request = "500m"
    cpu_limit = "1"
    memory_request = "256Mi"
    memory_limit = "8Gi"
    service_cpu_request = "100m"
    service_cpu_limit = "1"
    service_memory_request = "50Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"
    helper_cpu_request = "5m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "50Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "200Mi"
    # Used by bubblewrap
    cap_add = ["NET_ADMIN", "SYS_ADMIN"]
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-emptydir"
      mount_path = "/var/run"
      medium = "Memory"
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "apk-repo-pvc"
      mount_path = "/apks"
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "kubernetes.io/arch" = "amd64"

[[runners]]
  [runners.kubernetes]
    helper_image = "ghcr.io/vaskozl/gitlab-runner-helper:latest"
    cpu_request = "500m"
    cpu_limit = "1"
    memory_request = "2Gi"
    memory_limit = "7Gi"
    service_cpu_request = "100m"
    service_cpu_limit = "1"
    service_memory_request = "50Mi"
    service_memory_limit = "1Gi"
    helper_cpu_request = "5m"
    helper_cpu_limit = "500m"
    helper_memory_request = "50Mi"
    helper_memory_limit = "200Mi"
    poll_interval = 5
    poll_timeout = 600
    # Used by bubblewrap
    cap_add = ["NET_ADMIN", "SYS_ADMIN"]
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.empty_dir]]
      name = "docker-emptydir"
      mount_path = "/var/run"
      medium = "Memory"
    [[runners.kubernetes.volumes.pvc]]
      name = "apk-repo-pvc"
      mount_path = "/apks"
    [runners.kubernetes.node_selector]
      "kubernetes.io/arch" = "arm64"

targets:
  # Public DNS Servers (IPv4)
  - hosts:
      - 1.1.1.1              # Cloudflare Primary
      - 1.0.0.1              # Cloudflare Secondary
      - 8.8.8.8              # Google Primary
      - 8.8.4.4              # Google Secondary
      - 9.9.9.9              # Quad9 Primary
      # 149.112.112.112 is used for WAN2 gateway monitoring in OPNsense
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56

  # Internet Services
  - hosts:
      - google.com
      - github.com
      - cnn.com
      - ghcr.io
    interval: 1s
    network: ip4
    protocol: icmp
    size: 56

generic:
  enabled: true
  outbound: false
  allowJsTransformationFunctions: true
  waitForComplete: false
